skygo plan task.yaml --workdir-ref ref.json --output out --env 'REQUIRED=a,b=c'
stdout '^local$'
skygo run -f task.yaml --workdir-ref ref-string.json --output out --env 'REQUIRED='
stdout 'succeeded'
stdin task.yaml
skygo plan - --workdir-ref ref.json --output out --env 'REQUIRED=x'
stdout '^local$'

workdir: .
setup: echo setup
envs: {REQUIRED: null}
run: echo "$REQUIRED"
